verdict.rationale: Editor language-service integration is a fair axis for a TypeScript UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents an Angular language service, editor autocompletion, or inline template type errors. The CLI terminal autocompletion item (angular-docs-26) is an adjacent shell feature and earns no credit. Generic 'incredible tooling' claims are not evidence of this capability. An old community report even describes template strings getting no intellisense or compile-time errors, so the verdict stays at none.
